name: bench-slack
description: Relay messages through BenchAGI's Slack relay infrastructure. NOT IMPLEMENTED YET: every tool returns HTTP 501 not_implemented after auth + validation — nothing is sent, queued, or readable. Intended: wraps sessions.create (open new thread) and sessions.send (send on cached sessionKey); all calls carry the user's Bench UID and the relay enforces the per-tenant Slack bot token.

tools.name: slack_session_create
tools.description: NOT IMPLEMENTED — the server returns HTTP 501 not_implemented; nothing is sent or queued. Do NOT report the message as sent. (Intended: open a new Slack relay session — resolve the recipient (Bench UID or email), pick the right channel/DM, post the first message, return a sessionKey for follow-ups in the same thread.)

body_schema.message: string (first message text; supports Slack mrkdwn)

tools.name: slack_session_send
tools.description: NOT IMPLEMENTED — the server returns HTTP 501 not_implemented; nothing is sent or queued. Do NOT report the message as sent. (Intended: send a follow-up message on an existing sessionKey, same thread; sessionKey TTL 1 hour.)

tools.name: slack_history
tools.description: NOT IMPLEMENTED — the server returns HTTP 501 not_implemented; there is no thread history to read. (Intended: read recent messages in a thread the caller has relay access to — never arbitrary channel history.)
